title: diasperus macrophyllus
intro: Diasperus macrophyllus, commonly known as Chinese angelica, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae, native to China and other parts of Asia. It is known for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce fever, alleviate menstrual cramps, and improve blood circulation. The therapeutic actions of Chinese angelica include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antioxidant effects, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Diasperus macrophyllus include ferulic acid, ligustilide, and butylphthalide, among others, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
